layers.title: THEMIS Day IR Global Mosaic
layers.productType: Daytime thermal infrared brightness (not thermal inertia)
layers.source: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Arizona State University, Mars Odyssey THEMIS Day IR Global Mosaic v2.0 (ASU Mars Global Data Sets)
layers.citation: THEMIS Day IR Global Mosaic v2.0, ASU Mars Global Data Sets; NASA Mars Odyssey THEMIS daytime infrared (12.57 micrometre).
layers.description: Daytime thermal infrared (12.57 micrometre) brightness mosaic from Mars Odyssey THEMIS. The published global mosaic is 256 ppd; this browser texture is an 8K equirectangular colorized resample assembled from ASU JMARS WMS cells. No-data gores and unavailable cells are transparent.
layers.attribution: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Arizona State University, Mars Odyssey THEMIS Day IR Global Mosaic v2.0 (ASU Mars Global Data Sets)

thermalRamp.note: The published mosaic is an 8-bit relative brightness product, not a calibrated kinetic-temperature grid.
